opening.argument: The video demonstrates a trading process grounded in observable exchange prices and transaction steps. It shows XRP/USDT prices across exchanges, a trading interface with buy and sell controls, and a transfer of XRP to an exchange before converting it back to USDT. Its guidance also tells viewers to account for fees and transfer times and to test with small amounts before scaling. A wallet banner mentions a gas-free swap and potential prize, but the available evidence does not connect that banner to the trading method or establish that it produced any reward or loss. The demonstrated workflow and stated cautions support an instructional reading.

citations.quote: Then I select the full number of XRP I have and send it to the exchange.
Always consider fees, transfer times, and test the process with small amounts before scaling.
